text:
Aria (Sales): Passing Sunward Biotech to CS - 150-seat pilot, US & EU regions, want private deploy (VPC) + SAML SSO + token billing exports. Pilot target go-live 2025-08-04. They'll run synthetic PII in evals and asked for audit logs + HSM later. Please own onboarding and call out infra/compliance blockers.

Diego (CS): Thanks Aria. Quick q: who is their infra contact and expected pilot concurrency? Also capture any renewal signals.

Aria (Sales): Contact is Erin (Sunward infra). Expected concurrency ~40 users pilot, ramp to 250 in 3 months. Renewal interest: asked about 12-month commit and volume discount tiers.

Diego (CS): Noted. Top risks: private deploy lead time, SSO handoff, billing export format, audit log PII handling. Owners (tentative): Diego (onboarding lead), Nina (support/runbook), Harper (eng infra), Aria (sales sponsor). I'll schedule kickoff and create support ticket.

onboard-bot: Support ticket created: #SUP-7551 "Sunward private deploy + SSO + billing export" assigned to Nina.

Nina (Support): Runbook stub in SUP-7551: - Validate SAML metadata exchange - VPC peering & CIDR - Billing export schema (CSV vs JSON) - Audit log retention & redaction rules - Provisioning ETA for dedicated pool.

Harper (Eng): Important: model family and max seq length will change GPU footprint. If they use ~13B gen we can fit 2xA40 equiv; for 70B they'll need 6xA100. Confirm before provisioning. Also note: dedicated capacity lead time ~7-12 business days depending on region.

Diego (CS): Action list: 1) Kickoff + enablement deck (owner: Diego) 2) Support ticket + runbook (owner: Nina) 3) Confirm model & seq length (owner: Aria -> Erin) 4) Billing export spec + sample (owner: Diego + Billing Ops) 5) Provision dedicated pool after model confirmed (owner: Harper) 6) Draft 1-page SSO checklist for Erin's team (owner: Diego).

Aria (Sales): I'll ask Erin for model choices and billing cadence today. Will also surface the renewal interest and ask legal about contract timing.

Nina (Support): I'll add a testing checklist to SUP-7551: small ingest test -> SAML login test -> audit log verification -> perf smoke (p50/p95).

Diego (CS): Scheduled kickoff invite for 2025-07-22 10:00 PT (Sunward, Harper, Nina, Aria). I'll post the enablement slides link in the ticket. Also adding a "renewal-watch" tag with 9-month touchpoints in SFDC.

Harper (Eng): I'll estimate provisioning ETA in SUP-7551 after Aria confirms model. If it's 70B float we'll need ~10 business days to stand up dedicated capacity.

Aria (Sales): Good. Anything else? :thumbsup:

Diego (CS): Please keep updates in SUP-7551 and the calendar. I'll post the 1-page SSO checklist here before EOD for Erin.
